_note: The website id is a public, client-side id: it ships in the page either way. Blank it and this package goes inert on every lane rather than failing, so a fork of this repo does not report into our account.
_script: Where the browser lane loads the vendor script from. Ours is a first-party reverse proxy so a blocker that drops datafa.st does not drop us; `origin` is the fallback for a host with no proxy configured.
_endpoint: The ingest endpoint the NATIVE lanes post to directly. Point it at your own proxy to keep phone traffic first-party too.
